name: no-resolving-credential-409
description: A target the principal can see but for which no credential resolves is a legitimate state — listed, not connectable — and is answered 409 no_resolving_credential, never 403, which would read as a policy error. Needs a target id configured that way (input target_no_cred_id). Published at e0, required green at e1: the lab seeds this input with the E1 harness, since phase-00 seeds one superadmin.

error.message: no credential resolves for this target
